summary: Frontend-only retest of WhatsApp configuration fix. All requested flows PASS: whatsapp-fab on /, /properties, /about, /contact calls window.open('https://wa.me/918920785645?text=...', '_blank', 'noopener') with prefilled text and no 'not configured' toast; a real (unstubbed) popup also opened and redirected to api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=918920785645. Homepage cta-whatsapp-link opens wa.me/918920785645. Property detail desktop property-whatsapp and mobile (390px) sticky WhatsApp link open wa.me/918920785645 with title, price, location, Ref (8-char id) and URL. property-call href=tel:+918920785645; footer-phone shows '+91 89207 85645'. Admin lead detail: textarea editable, lead-whatsapp-open href updates live to https://wa.me/91<phone>?text=<edited>, target=_blank; copy button shows toast and clipboard contains edited text. Regression: explore-* links open /properties?listing_type=buy with 9 results; Estate Mitra chat opens and replies sensibly.

issues: Follow-up date uses native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
